title: Ordinary native relay addressing between sibling satellites lacks a direct pair
outcome: Ordinary native relay addressing between sibling satellites lacks a direct pair
acceptance: Document the supported sibling-satellite delivery and wake contract, distinguishing canonical domain mail from explicit native relay delivery and identifying which behavior is currently unsupported.
Independently agree any future native-delivery design and criteria before implementing topology or wake-owner changes; retain exact recipient identity, authority fencing and retained-key behavior.
